_meta.purpose: Protection-only glossary — DO NOT use this to enforce translation style. It exists solely to prevent DeepL from 'over-translating' acronyms, proper nouns, and brand/product names that must remain identical in Korean output.
_meta.policy: Only add a term here if leaving it untranslated is obviously correct REGARDLESS of sentence context. For everything else, let DeepL decide and review the diff report.
_meta.scope: 15 entries — acronyms + proper nouns + product names only.
rejected_categories: General accounting verbs (Assurance, Audit, Compliance, etc.) — DeepL handles these fine, no need to lock
HK-specific tax names (Profits Tax, Salaries Tax, VAT) — review in diff report instead of pre-committing a guess
Descriptive phrases (Transfer Pricing, Due Diligence) — same reason
